title: One in four US adults reports trouble with memory
context: One in four US adults now reports difficulty remembering or concentrating, up from one in six in 2019, while feelings of depression held flat. The survey records what people report, not why.
ask: What could make memory and concentration worse across a whole population: illness, medication, stress, or something no survey asks about? This archive documents reports of unconsented technological harassment; no dataset here can show whether it plays any part.
